unit.why: An anecdote: R. Moshe asks the Lublin rebbe why he takes snuff during prayer, and the rebbe answers with a parable.

stories.start_quote: בספר רמ"צ א״ר פ"י אות י"ג
stories.end_quote: א״כ סובל ג"כ ההפסק שלנו עכדה"ק עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin used to take snuff in the middle of prayer; when R. Moshe son of R. Zalman objected that one should not interrupt, the rebbe answered with a parable of a king who chose a poor old fiddler whose strings kept snapping, and so bears his interruptions.

quotes: שהי׳ דרכו בתוך התפלה לשאוף אבק הטאביק
